verdict: Retain a narrow provisional minor/null finding for internal addition; the aggregate effect is conditional.
read_extent: All 10 original author pages read. The original table on physical page 10 was visually checked. Related committee report BT 21/2774, physical pages 1–6, read, including operative pages 3–4 and the request to examine creditor financing. Did not independently verify the full later mediation chronology or the KGSt inputs.
strongest_rescues: An input may be a typo: operating costs of EUR 2,000 rather than EUR 9,700 would make the printed total exact. EUR 129,430 is therefore not unconditionally the intended corrected cost.

The national headline is expressly a minimum, rather than an independently validated exact need. Physical page 9 distinguishes existing finance from additional public spending and explicitly says the additional need cannot reliably be quantified. A larger conditional model does not itself make a lower bound false.
The model is transparent and illustrative. Staffing parameters, actual underfunding and the merits of creditor contributions were not independently validated.
request_linkage: Request 3 and physical pages 7–9 seek permanent reliable public funding with supplementary creditor contributions. The inconsistent arithmetic sits within the cost model supporting that request.
severity_reason: Minor is appropriate because the high-confidence issue is inconsistent addition of three printed rows, rather than proven national funding need. The possible EUR 25.795 million consequence is worth reporting conditionally, but does not justify major severity under these reservations.
direction_reason: Null retained: a smaller headline could make the proposal appear cheaper while also reducing the funds sought for providers. No net direction has been established.
quote_policy: No additional original quotations added; the existing aggregate quotation budget is preserved.
